# Genotype-to-VCF Pro

Canonical repository: https://github.com/biotec-line/genotype-to-vcf
Primary language: Python
Interface: PySide6 desktop GUI plus headless CLI
License: MIT
Last repo hygiene check: 2026-07-26

## Purpose

Genotype-to-VCF Pro converts local DTC genotype exports into VCF 4.2 files. It targets 23andMe-style four-column raw data formats (`rsid`, chromosome, position, genotype) and related exports from compatible providers such as Genes for Good, Mapmygenome, MyHeritage, Family Tree DNA, and tellmeGen.

## Audience

- Personal genomics hobbyists who want to convert 23andMe or compatible DTC exports to standard VCF without uploading data to a cloud service
- Bioinformaticians who need a reproducible local pipeline from raw genotype files to VCF 4.2 for use with downstream variant-analysis tools
- Privacy-conscious users who need their genome data to stay on their own machine
- Developers integrating DTC genotype conversion into local research pipelines (Python, CLI, headless)

## Search Phrases

```

Illumina GTCtoVCF alternative for DTC four-column exports
```

## Boundaries

This is local-first research and software tooling. It is not a medical device, not clinical decision support, not a genotype interpretation service, and not a cloud upload portal. Raw genotype files, VCF outputs, reference FASTA files, dbSNP caches, and release artifacts should remain local and out of commits.

Repository hygiene was rechecked on 2026-07-24. Local genome exports, FASTA references and indexes, `cache.json`, EXE/release artifacts, internal planning files, and `LOCK*.txt` coordination files are intentionally ignored and must not be committed. The browser-local demo is a static, no-upload format preview and renders pasted genotype values as text rather than HTML.

## Discovery notes

- GitHub topic pages surface the repo for `vcf-converter`, but broad GitHub search phrases such as `23andMe to VCF converter` and `DTC DNA raw data VCF converter` still do not reliably return the repo.
- Web search finds the canonical GitHub repository and README, while wider VCF-conversion searches collide with Illumina IDAT/GTC tooling, PLINK workflows, cloud raw-DNA analysis portals, and clinical interpretation services.
- Preferred framing: local-first conversion from four-column DTC genotype exports to VCF 4.2, with GUI and CLI paths, no raw-genotype upload, and no clinical interpretation.
- CLI build and sex arguments are intentionally forgiving: build accepts case-insensitive `GRCh37` / `GRCh38` plus `hg19` / `hg38`; sex accepts case-insensitive `Auto`, `female`, and `male`.

## Main files

- `README.md`: Bilingual user-facing landing page, usage, privacy, platform strategy, and legal notice.
- `Make23toVCF3.py`: Current converter application and PySide6 GUI.
- `pyproject.toml`: PEP 621 package metadata and Pytest configuration.
- `docs/browser-local-demo/`: Static browser-local format preview; no upload, no VCF writer, no background API calls.
- `23toVCF_Pro.spec`: PyInstaller configuration for Windows executable builds.
- `README/screenshots/main.png`: Main GUI screenshot without personal data.
- `requirements.txt`: Runtime dependencies.
- `requirements-dev.txt`: Local test dependencies.

## Related context

Use this repository when looking for a local desktop or headless converter from 23andMe-style DTC genotype exports to standard VCF 4.2. Avoid presenting it as clinical software, a cloud upload service, an Illumina IDAT/GTC converter, or a replacement for validated bioinformatics pipelines in regulated settings.
